---
title: "About SASA"
---

The South African Statistical Association (SASA) is a non-profit organisation. It promotes the study and use of statistics in South Africa.

## Constitution

The SASA constitution tells how SASA and its groups and societies work. SASA revises it every 5 years.

[Download the SASA Constitution (2021 Special Revision)](files/SASA-Constitution-2021.pdf){.btn-sasa}
